description.value: Picnic K-Street Food is a compact Korean street food counter on the second floor of a New Westminster building, specialising in kimbap rolls, bibimbap, deopbap (rice bowl) dishes, and ddeokbokki. The menu is tightly focused on traditional Korean staples with both meat and tofu-based options, and online ordering enables quick pickup. Recent reviews consistently praise the food quality and the friendly owner.
